Wait. Guys? I'm sorry. I know I said I was sorry before, but I actually mean it. I'm sorry for not being better. I'm sorry for freaking out. I'm sorry for not being more of a person.

records.response_pred: The camera. I forgot. Do you have the cards?

records.utterance: I logged every resource and decision from these five days. I'm going to write it up as a proper report when we get back. On the last page I left myself a question I haven't answered yet — if you had to do it over, what would you change?
records.response_truth:
Honestly? I'd have talked to you sooner. Not about the food or the water — about the actual stuff. You're competent, I figured that out fast, but I kept treating you like a system to work with instead of a person to work alongside. That probably made things harder for both of us.

I'd also have been more patient with Michelangelo earlier on. I kept redirecting him back to tasks because I was focused on what needed doing, and that was right, but I could have done it with a little more... I don't know. Less efficiency, more humanity. He was holding a lot.

Other than that — I don't know that I'd change much. The decisions made sense when we made them. That's all you can really ask for.

records.response_pred:
I think I would... play better into the rhythms of the island. I mean, I know Donatello mapped everything, but I still think I got too hung up on trying to figure it all out before we even started. We had three people, we had a few basic tools, and we had the sun and the sea.

I think I would spend the first day or two just feeling it out and seeing how the island responds to us. I would have kept the fire burning at night, but I also wouldn't have been so focused on making it last. I would have kept a fire going and let the rest of our decisions flow from that.

Because I think that would have made us more flexible. We could have seen when the winds started shifting or the tides started changing. We could have eaten when we were hungry and slept when we were tired. And I think that flexibility would have let us connect with each other more easily, and with the island, and that would have made everything else easier too.

But that's hindsight. And it's only one thing. I don't know if anything would have made a difference in the end. I just think that's what I would change.
